data_provenance: pinned public owner-maintained mirror; not organizer-authenticated

gate.criterion: nested outer-fold mean delta > 0 and at least the registered number of positive tiles against both tmi_hg and the frozen H35-01 incumbent, with matched actual pixel mass across challenger, baseline and incumbent in every outer tile
gate.slot_note: Local proxy CV never spends a competition slot; a pass still requires official-data provenance review and human decision. Historical quadrant exposure means this is exploratory, not pristine independent confirmation.

generative_ai_use.competitor_responsibility: The registered competitor must independently verify code, scientific claims, data rights/provenance, artifact validity, and all final submission statements.
generative_ai_use.extent: Arena.ai Agent Mode assisted with source review, geological-hypothesis framing, design-of-experiments planning, code implementation, test design, and documentation. The repository scripts generated the raster and experiment artifacts from the local inputs.

holdout_reuse_note: H35-01/H35-02 previously reported aggregate scores over all four coarse quadrants, exposing labels in these 3x2 tiles; the middle row also crosses the earlier north/south boundary. Each outer tile is excluded from its own LHS selection in this nested run, but this is exploratory spatial CV, not a pristine independent replication.

incumbent.comparison: rescored at each selected challenger's prediction fraction and matched to identical actual emitted mass

feature_band_descriptions.1: mag_anom - Magnetic anomaly - deviation from expected Earth's magnetic field
feature_band_descriptions.10: deq_n100a15 - Distance to earthquake (n=100km radius, a=15° azimuth parameters)
feature_band_descriptions.11: iso_grav_anom_vg - Isostatic gravity anomaly vertical gradient - vertical rate of change
feature_band_descriptions.12: det_elev - Detrended elevation - topography with regional trends removed
feature_band_descriptions.13: iso_grav_anom - Isostatic gravity anomaly - gravity after compensating for topographic mass
feature_band_descriptions.14: tmi - Total magnetic intensity - total strength of magnetic field
feature_band_descriptions.15: depth_to_base_surf - Depth to basement surface - thickness of sedimentary cover
feature_band_descriptions.16: ieq_n100a15 - Earthquake intensity or density (n=100km radius, a=15° parameters)
feature_band_descriptions.17: cond_surf - Conductivity surface - electrical conductivity of subsurface
feature_band_descriptions.18: iso_grav_anom_hg - Isostatic gravity anomaly horizontal gradient - horizontal rate of change
feature_band_descriptions.19: det_elev_slope - Detrended elevation slope - gradient of elevation after detrending
feature_band_descriptions.2: rtp - Reduced to pole magnetic data - magnetic anomaly corrected for latitude effects
feature_band_descriptions.3: tmi_hg - Total magnetic intensity horizontal gradient - rate of change in horizontal direction
feature_band_descriptions.4: geod_2ndinv - Geodetic second invariant - measure of strain rate tensor magnitude
feature_band_descriptions.5: iso_grav_anom_slope - Isostatic gravity anomaly slope - gradient of gravity after isostatic correction
feature_band_descriptions.6: tc - Tilt angle or total curvature - magnetic field derivative for edge detection
feature_band_descriptions.7: geod_shearrate - Geodetic shear rate - rate of angular deformation from GPS/InSAR
feature_band_descriptions.8: geod_dilaterate - Geodetic dilatation rate - rate of volumetric strain (expansion/contraction)
feature_band_descriptions.9: tmi_vg - Total magnetic intensity vertical gradient - rate of change in vertical direction
